intro: Your adventure may be sweet, but survival won't be easy.
description:
Welcome to a colorful world of candy, adventure, and survival. You play as a brave little gummy bear stranded on a mysterious sweet island, where escaping will require more than just finding the way home.

Explore the island, gather valuable resources, and visit different workshops to craft and improve the tools you need for your journey. At your campsite, develop your character's abilities and become stronger, faster, and better prepared for the challenges ahead.

You won't have to face the island alone. Along the way, you'll meet friendly companions who can join you and help gather resources, making your journey a little easier.

Discover the secrets of the sweet island, upgrade your abilities, collect resources, and find a way to escape.
